payload.title: Machines on Machines: the article Story type has no public address
payload.description: web/projection.json in AnthusAI/Machines-on-Machines declares storyTypes post and article, but urls.types has only post at /posts/. An article Story has no declared address, and listings include article. The sitemap shows no Story pages yet, so this first Story is likely to be the site's first test of the address scheme.
